How to use this report
What you're looking at

Every store across the 5 active rep books (439 accounts) is scored 0–100 based on five signals pulled from the sales data and Zoho rep visit logs. The score tells you how commercially healthy each relationship is right now — not just whether they're buying, but whether they're growing, buying broadly, and being regularly visited. Data as at 15 May 2026.

Reporting windows used:

  • 3-month window: Feb 2026 – May 2026
  • 6-month window: Nov 2025 – May 2026
  • 12-month window: May 2025 – May 2026
  • Dormant threshold: No purchase since 14 Feb 2026
The four tiers
  • 🟢 Active & Growing — Buying regularly across multiple categories, spend trending up. Protect these accounts — they're your core book.
  • 🟡 Active but Narrow — Buying consistently but only 1–2 product categories. Clearest upsell opportunity — they already trust you.
  • 🟠 At-Risk — Purchase frequency declining, or rep visiting but store not buying. Needs rep attention this week.
  • 🔴 Dead / Dormant — No purchase since 14 Feb 2026. Decision required: re-activate or remove from cycle plan.
The five metrics (click any row to expand)
  • Purchase Frequency (25%) — Orders per month measured over three windows: Feb 2026 – May 2026, Nov 2025 – May 2026, and May 2025 – May 2026. The 6-month window drives the score. Saturates at 4 orders/month.
  • Rep Visit Cadence (15%) — Zoho check-ins per month over Nov 2025 – May 2026. Penalised if the rep is visiting but the store hasn't bought since 14 Feb 2026 — a warning sign.
  • Basket Coverage (30%) — Of the 11 product categories, what % has this store purchased over May 2025 – May 2026? Highest-weighted metric — broad basket = deep wallet share.
  • SKU Depth (15%) — Within each category bought over May 2025 – May 2026, how many of our available SKUs have they purchased? Low depth = upsell gap inside a category they already buy.
  • Rand Value Trend (15%) — Linear slope of monthly spend over Nov 2025 – May 2026, adjusted for the 10% April 2026 price increase. Score 50 = flat; above 50 = growing volume; below 50 = declining.
How to action it
  • Filter by rep using the name buttons below — use this in weekly rep reviews to focus on one book at a time.
  • Filter by tier to surface the stores that need action. Start with 🟠 At-Risk: check if a visit is scheduled.
  • Click any row to expand the full five-metric breakdown for that store, including the exact date windows, spend trend, and category-by-category detail.
  • Search by store name or delivery reference (e.g. "KA003") to jump directly to an account.
  • Sort by Health Score, Name, Frequency, or Categories using the dropdown — useful for spotting the weakest accounts in a rep's book.
  • The Spend (Feb 2026 – May 2026) column shows the last three monthly totals as a quick trend read (e.g. R45k → R38k → R28k = declining).

How to use this report
What you're looking at

Every store across the 5 active rep books (439 accounts) is scored 0–100 based on five signals pulled from the sales data and Zoho rep visit logs. The score tells you how commercially healthy each relationship is right now — not just whether they're buying, but whether they're growing, buying broadly, and being regularly visited. Data as at 15 May 2026.

Reporting windows used:

  • 3-month window: Feb 2026 – May 2026
  • 6-month window: Nov 2025 – May 2026
  • 12-month window: May 2025 – May 2026
  • Dormant threshold: No purchase since 14 Feb 2026
The four tiers
  • 🟢 Active & Growing — Buying regularly across multiple categories, spend trending up. Protect these accounts — they're your core book.
  • 🟡 Active but Narrow — Buying consistently but only 1–2 product categories. Clearest upsell opportunity — they already trust you.
  • 🟠 At-Risk — Purchase frequency declining, or rep visiting but store not buying. Needs rep attention this week.
  • 🔴 Dead / Dormant — No purchase since 14 Feb 2026. Decision required: re-activate or remove from cycle plan.
The five metrics (click any row to expand)
  • Purchase Frequency (25%) — Orders per month measured over three windows: Feb 2026 – May 2026, Nov 2025 – May 2026, and May 2025 – May 2026. The 6-month window drives the score. Saturates at 4 orders/month.
  • Rep Visit Cadence (15%) — Zoho check-ins per month over Nov 2025 – May 2026. Penalised if the rep is visiting but the store hasn't bought since 14 Feb 2026 — a warning sign.
  • Basket Coverage (30%) — Of the 11 product categories, what % has this store purchased over May 2025 – May 2026? Highest-weighted metric — broad basket = deep wallet share.
  • SKU Depth (15%) — Within each category bought over May 2025 – May 2026, how many of our available SKUs have they purchased? Low depth = upsell gap inside a category they already buy.
  • Rand Value Trend (15%) — Linear slope of monthly spend over Nov 2025 – May 2026, adjusted for the 10% April 2026 price increase. Score 50 = flat; above 50 = growing volume; below 50 = declining.
How to action it
  • Filter by rep using the name buttons below — use this in weekly rep reviews to focus on one book at a time.
  • Filter by tier to surface the stores that need action. Start with 🟠 At-Risk: check if a visit is scheduled.
  • Click any row to expand the full five-metric breakdown for that store, including the exact date windows, spend trend, and category-by-category detail.
  • Search by store name or delivery reference (e.g. "KA003") to jump directly to an account.
  • Sort by Health Score, Name, Frequency, or Categories using the dropdown — useful for spotting the weakest accounts in a rep's book.
  • The Spend (Feb 2026 – May 2026) column shows the last three monthly totals as a quick trend read (e.g. R45k → R38k → R28k = declining).
